about.font_melete: The SF theme uses bundled Melete Bold (SIL OFL 1.1, https://dotcolon.net/font/melete/) for English heading labels (logo, MISSION / QUEST / EMINENCE, OBJECTIVE / REWARD / LOCATION, and similar words). Body text and Japanese stay Meiryo. The full license is in fonts/melete/OFL.txt.
about.title: About
about.update_notice_note: When a newer version is published, you are notified in chat and on screen on load, and can choose Download and update when the notice includes a zip location (checked once in the background; nothing happens when offline).

roe.accept_tip: Sends the same "Accept" as the game menu, once.
roe.detail_hint: Select a name in the list to see its details here.
roe.empty.no_favs: No favorites yet. Press the heart in the list to add one.
roe.empty.no_pins: Only starred objectives are shown. Turn off "Pinned only" and press ☆.
roe.empty.unknown: No objective record yet (it arrives when you log in or change areas).
roe.fav: Add to favorites (shown by "Favorites" in the book; not the window)
roe.favs_only_tip: Shows only objectives marked with the heart, from every category. Swap them here with Accept/Cancel (sent once per press). Does not affect the window.
roe.hide: Hide the Eminence window (turns off "Show Eminence")
roe.hide_completed_tip: Repeatable records stay visible even when completed. Only non-repeatable completed ones are hidden. When off, completed ones (not taken) are dimmed.
roe.msg.busy: Just sent. Waiting for the answer.
roe.msg.full: You can take up to 30. Cancel one first.
roe.msg.not_impl: This record is not implemented on this server.
roe.msg.not_this_week: Unity leader objectives rotate weekly. This one is not this week's, so it can't be taken now.
roe.msg.not_today: Unity shared objectives rotate daily (at 00:00 JST). Today only Shared {today} ({from}–{to}) can be taken.
roe.msg.other_leader: This belongs to another Unity leader. Only your own Unity leader's objectives can be taken.
roe.msg.timed_auto: Timed objectives are added by the game every 4 hours. They can't be taken by hand.
roe.msg.unable_named: The game said {name} can't be taken.
roe.msg.unable_rotating: The game said {name} can't be taken now. Unity objectives rotate by day and week, and this one is not today's (this week's).
roe.msg.unknown: Not available until the objective record arrives.
roe.no_cat_dat: Category data could not be read; shown without categories.
roe.no_dat: Could not read the game data file ({why}).
roe.no_record: No objective record yet. Buttons wait until it arrives.
roe.pin: Star (shown in the window by "Pinned only")
roe.pin_only_tip: When on, only objectives marked ★ are shown.
roe.remove_tip: Sends the same "cancel" as the game menu, once. Progress goes back to 0.
roe.search_more: Showing the first {n}. Add words to narrow it down.
roe.show_completed_tip: On: show every completed record. Off: hide only non-repeatable completed ones (repeatable ones stay visible). Shown completed records are dimmed.
roe.show_unimplemented_tip: On: show records that are not implemented on this server (they appear dimmed). Off: hide unimplemented records that are not accepted (accepted ones stay visible). Hidden records are also left out of heading totals.
save.failed_once: Could not save. Your changes are kept and will be retried.
settings.alpha_note: "Other" opacity covers notices and the entry icon.
settings.color_note: Click a color swatch to open the color picker. A gradient goes from the start color on the left to the end color on the right. If the game's text box can't use color codes, only the start color is shown.
settings.compass_visible: Show the compass (quests to take in this area, nearest first)
settings.debug_note: For checking only. Normally accepted/completed comes from the game log. /astertrail debug buttons also toggles it.
settings.debug_state_buttons: Show buttons to set Not accepted / Accepted / Completed by hand
settings.fold_note: Left and right open or close a heading. Confirm does not open it. Confirm moves into the section; cancel returns to the heading (same as the book).
settings.font_body_fx_note: When on, the outline and shadow below apply to book lists and details, the tracker, eminence, map, and settings descriptions (capped at 3 px; tracker and compass stay at 1 px so small text stays readable). Off (default) leaves body text unchanged.
settings.font_crisp_note: Loads the selected Windows fonts at a large size close to the current text scale and does not stretch the glyphs. Turn it off to restore the previous look. Fonts come from Windows and are not bundled with the addon. For SF English headings only, the bundled Melete Bold is used (falls back to the current font if it cannot be loaded).
settings.font_crisp_outline_note: Adds a black outline only when the crisp font is on. It is not drawn when the crisp font is off. 0 keeps the current look. Color is black only. No shadow.
settings.font_face_note: Choose from fonts installed on Windows. The default is Meiryo for Japanese, Latin and numbers, matching the current look. Reload the addon after changing. If a font cannot be read, that slot falls back to Meiryo, then to the previous drawing if Meiryo is also missing.
settings.font_face_reload: Reload the addon to apply the font change.
settings.font_face_split_no: Fonts are not split right now. Latin and numbers are shown in the Japanese font (or the default), not the ones you chose.
settings.font_face_split_partial: Japanese and Latin are split, but numbers still use the Latin font (glyph ranges could not be applied).
settings.font_note: Changing text size does not change window sizes or the overhead icon size. "Other" covers settings, notices and the entry icon. The compass uses the tracker text size. "List" covers only the heading tree and the list table in the book. "Tab text size" applies only to tab labels when the tracker is in tab view (if you have not set it, it follows the tracker text size).
settings.font_style_note: Outline and shadow apply to decorated headings and notices. To use them on body text, turn on "Apply to body text" just under this heading. Body thickness and shadow distance are capped at 3 px. Off (default) leaves body text unchanged. They cannot be applied to labels inside standard ImGui widgets such as buttons, sliders, or window titles. Overhead quest and object-name shadows are not applied in this version.
settings.gameui_capture: Pause game menus while using the book
settings.gameui_menus_on_top: Keep game menus in front while one is open
settings.gameui_note: While you use the book, game menus don't get your input. Close the book or click outside it to give it back.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.input_note: Keys and pad are taken only while you operate an addon window, never while the tracker is just visible. Click the game or press Esc/B to return input to the game.
settings.layout_empty: Nothing saved in this slot yet.
settings.layout_no_dir: Cannot save layouts; the config folder is unknown.
settings.layouts_tip: Saves each window's place, size, and show/hide, plus look and column settings. Progress, pins, favorites, fame, and debug are not included. Load moves the windows right away.
settings.marks_bg_alpha_note: The default matches the current look (80%). The object-name setting also applies to nearby object names.
settings.marks_bg_color_note: The default background color is the previous black. A gradient is a plate drawn behind the text. Outline thickness is 0–8 (1 as before, 0 for none). Outline opacity uses the official stroke color. World text boxes have no shadow, so a second copy of the text is placed slightly behind in the shadow color. Shadow on/off, color, distance, and opacity use the same controls as Look.
settings.marks_no_enlarge_near_note: When on, overhead text and icons stop growing closer than 16 yalms (they still shrink with distance). Off (the default) keeps the current look.
settings.marks_no_project: Screen positions are not available yet, so marks may not appear.
settings.marks_note: Icons are only placed on visible targets. For talking NPCs, the icon sits beside the name and the quest name goes above it. For examine objects, the icon sits to the left of the object's name (such as ???) and the quest name goes above that row. Multiple quests on the same person stack upward. They are not shown off-screen or on unloaded targets. Examine objects are marked at the loaded object's position regardless of whether a name is shown. This version uses the prepared icon images.
settings.marks_placement_above_name: Above the name, quest name on the right
settings.marks_placement_obj_above_name: Quest name to the right of the icon
settings.marks_pos_note: + moves right/down. For examine objects, "Icon position" moves the icon and the name (??? etc.) together. "Quest name position" moves only the quest name. "Reset positions" sets everything to 0. "Nearby object names" position moves only the nearby object names (separate from quest object names). With both quest object names and nearby object names on, a quest object's name uses the quest object position.
settings.marks_pos_other: Position: others (talk NPCs, targets, gate guards)
settings.marks_show_fame: Show icons for NPCs who tell your fame
settings.marks_switches_note: Each of the four switches shows or hides only what its name says. Icons: the quest marker icons (talk NPCs, monsters and examine objects). Quest names: the quest name on a marker. Quest object names: the names of examine objects that are part of a quest (??? etc.). Nearby object names: the names of examine objects nearby (within 30 yalms; ???, doors and so on), with no icon. With quest object names off and nearby object names on, quest objects nearby still get their name. An object never gets two names. Fame icon: shown on the 7 NPCs who tell your fame (a magenta speech bubble), lowest priority; a quest icon on the same NPC wins. Hidden when icons are off.
settings.popup_note: Shown when you accept or finish a quest or mission in the game (not on login or zone re-reads). Pressing Pin / No thanks closes it at once. To choose with keys or a pad, use the tracker-operate shortcut or /astertrail notice.
settings.popup_try_note: Does not change your progress. Shows the notice and plays the sound.
settings.remember_position_note: When off, settings open at the first tab each time (window place and size are kept). The book always returns to the last tab, selected entry, and list position, whether this setting is on or off.
settings.reset_columns: Reset list column order and visibility
settings.reset_unstarted: Revert entries without an accepted flag to Not started
settings.reset_unstarted_note: Does not change anything the game log shows as accepted or completed. Quests and missions with no readable flag are skipped. For one entry, use the details button or /astertrail reset unstarted <id>.
settings.rings_hide_in_event_note: When on, rings are hidden during events (cutscenes and the like) and while a game menu is open, including NPC conversations, shops, and the main menu. On by default. If this setting is missing from a saved file, it is treated as on.
settings.rings_note: A ring of light at the feet of what you have a mark on (loaded only), in that mark's colour. It lies on the ground and is hidden by what stands in front. Up to 16, nearest first. The first colours are the icon colours.
settings.rings_strength_note: The official ring strength (0–4; 1 is the current look). 0 hides the ring; higher values make the glow stronger. When scene effects are unavailable, the same value is applied to the line's opacity.
settings.roe_hide_completed: Hide done objectives in the book (repeatable ones stay visible; dim when off)
settings.roe_note: Names, goals and repeatability come from the game data files. "Accept" and "Cancel" send once, only when pressed.
settings.shortcut_note: "Open book" opens the book when it is closed; when addon menus are open, closes all of them except the tracker. Does nothing while pad control (Input tab) is off. With "Also send to the game" off, the buttons are kept from the game from the moment the combo is complete until released (buttons pressed before that still reach the game). While you are using a menu, a button that is part of the combo (such as R1) does its usual action (R1 switches tabs) when you release it on its own. If the combo is completed, that action is skipped.
settings.shortcut_src_dinput: DirectInput (dinput_button; PlayStation pad button order; the D-pad cannot be used)
settings.shortcut_src_none: Nothing received yet (reads XInput pads and DirectInput pad buttons)
settings.shortcut_tracker_note: "Show/hide tracker" toggles the tracker each time you press it. "Operate tracker" lets you operate the tracker with the pad (it is shown if hidden; the book and other menus are closed). While operating, pad input is not passed to the game. Press it again, or cancel (B/○), to return to the game. Both are unset by default. The same combination cannot be used for two shortcuts.
settings.shortcut_waiting: Press buttons... (everything held together is added; release all to set)
settings.shortcut_windows_note: "Show/hide Eminence" and "Show/hide compass" toggle those windows each time you press them. Both are unset by default.
settings.tabs_hint: (LB/RB: switch tabs, Cancel: back to the list)
settings.title: Settings - Astertrail
settings.tracker_fold_note: You can also double-click an empty part of the tracker to collapse or expand it. Drag an empty part to move the window and the lower-right corner to resize it. The × at the top right hides it (show it again with "○ Tracker" in the book or "Show tracker" here).
settings.tracker_show_close: Show the × at the top right
settings.tracker_show_close_note: Without it, you can still hide the tracker with the "Show/hide tracker" shortcut, /astertrail tracker hide, or "Show tracker" here.
settings.tracker_view_note: With tabs, pinned entries are shown as same-width tabs on the top row and only the chosen one is shown. Long names are cut with "…"; hover to see the whole name. When they do not fit, ◀▶ scroll the row. LB/RB switch tabs on the pad, and operating starts inside the shown entry (one cancel returns to the game). The ▲▼ reorder buttons are not shown in tab view.
settings.tracker_visible_note: Shown whenever something is pinned. Turn this off to hide it.

sf.set.map_credit: Map images are not bundled; they are read from the client at run time.
sf.set.map_grid_alpha_help: At 0, lines and the outer scales are hidden. When you zoom, cell labels stay outside the map frame.
sf.set.marks_names_help: "Quest target names" are objects tied to a quest, such as ???. "Nearby object names" are names within 30 yalms, with no icon.

sf.set.preview_marks: Sample of overhead icons and names
sf.set.remember_position: When you open settings, start from the last category
sf.set.reset_unstarted: Revert entries without an accepted flag to unstarted
sf.set.shortcut_pass: Do not pass shortcut buttons through to the game while in use
sf.set.tracker_visible_help: You can also toggle it from the book's star.
sf.set.update_notice_help: If a newer build is available, you are notified in chat and on screen on load, and can update from the zip when the notice includes its location.
